svg.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Based Option Decision
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-evidence-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Based Option Decision; subtitle: Build a disciplined pipeline without pretending studies finish in one month.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone ending days. Activity counts are operating targets, not utility response commitments or closing forecasts. The canonical first-deal window remains 2–6 months, subject to site and study dependencies.; caption: Finish the sprint with documented proceed, revise, or reject decisions and a funded next step, rather than unsupported MW claims.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define two site theses and assemble forty candidates; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Create separate BESS and AI campus score sheets, a QGIS evidence register, utility contact records, and jurisdiction-specific zoning checklists. Record 69kV–345kV corridor signals without labeling unstudied substations as available capacity.; label: Days 8-14; value: Screen twelve priority parcels and initiate utility inquiries; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Investigate ownership, access, wetlands, flood exposure, mineral rights, and municipal moratoriums. Send site-specific load or storage profiles to utilities; log unanswered requests as unresolved dependencies rather than favorable technical findings.; label: Days 15-21; value: Negotiate three contingent option structures with capped exposure; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Seek 12–24 month assignable terms, staged fees, study access, extension pricing, and defined diligence exits. Obtain carrier route evidence for AI candidates and storage-specific charging and fire-access findings for BESS candidates.; label: Days 22-30; value: Prepare two buyer packages and decide next commitments; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Compile dated utility evidence, unresolved conditions, upgrade sensitivity, energization ranges, option rights, and expiration budgets. Authorize only affordable next steps; defer capacity-based pricing when utility documentation remains insufficient.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Based Option Decision
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Based Option Decision

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define two site theses and assemble forty candidates; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Create separate BESS and AI campus score sheets, a QGIS evidence register, utility contact records, and jurisdiction-specific zoning checklists. Record 69kV–345kV corridor signals without labeling unstudied substations as available capacity.

text.title: Define two site theses and assemble forty candidates

circle.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Screen twelve priority parcels and initiate utility inquiries; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Investigate ownership, access, wetlands, flood exposure, mineral rights, and municipal moratoriums. Send site-specific load or storage profiles to utilities; log unanswered requests as unresolved dependencies rather than favorable technical findings.

text.title: Screen twelve priority parcels and initiate utility inquiries

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Negotiate three contingent option structures with capped exposure; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Seek 12–24 month assignable terms, staged fees, study access, extension pricing, and defined diligence exits. Obtain carrier route evidence for AI candidates and storage-specific charging and fire-access findings for BESS candidates.

text.title: Negotiate three contingent option structures with capped exposure

circle.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Prepare two buyer packages and decide next commitments; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Compile dated utility evidence, unresolved conditions, upgrade sensitivity, energization ranges, option rights, and expiration budgets. Authorize only affordable next steps; defer capacity-based pricing when utility documentation remains insufficient.

text.title: Prepare two buyer packages and decide next commitments

Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone ending days. Activity counts are operating targets, not utility response commitments or closing forecasts. The canonical first-deal window remains 2–6 months, subject to site and study dependencies.
